posts.title: The book next to the book: embedding serendipity as pedagogy
posts.description: I have been thinking about libraries. Not in any systematic way, obviously, but in a wandering-about-rather-happily-confused sort of way. More specifically, I have been thinking about the book next to the book I was there to find. I have spent a lot of time wandering around university libraries looking for an actual physical book. posts.title: Efficiency and Wisdom?
posts.description: I was happy to be a co-author on a chapter for the Manifesto for Generative AI in Higher Education, The Book Project Our chapter is in response to statement 15 : Efficiency is seductive; wisdom lingers. The co-authors were the excellent Dr Nigel Francis, and Dr Kevin Campbell-Karn. Our chapter is at https://pressbooks.pub/mfaihe/chapter/efficiency-is-seductive-wisdom-lingers

posts.title: Against the Comfortable Curriculum
posts.description: At the University of Gloucestershire Festival of Learning, I was delighted to be invited to deliver a keynote lecture and spoke on the theme of Against the Comfortable Curriculum: Inclusion, Decolonisation, Justice, and the Trouble with “Good Practice”.
